tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya da sha badz+ra pā ṇi hri da ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon lag na rdo rje bcu'i ming shes sam/ rus shes sam/ gsang sngags shes pa de la byad gyis mi tshugs/ gnod sbyin dag rnam par 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro// srin po rnams dang*/ lhag ma za ba rnams dang*/ bdug pa za ba rnams 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro// phyis 'jog pa rnams kyang gnod par mi 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/ u ki ri/ ma ki ri/ ma rā tse par+ṇaṇa sha ba ri/ u li mi/ mi le me/ i li me/ mi le me/ i li ma la me/ i li mi le me/ hik+ke dhik+ke/ huk+ke/ dhu dhu re/ pra dha re/ a lam+pha le/ phā lam+pha le/ khu khu me ti ku me tu me/ khi ri khi ri sā dha sā dha/ sarba bak+ṣa la/ ban+dha ma bak+ka le/ kun dga' bo gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje bcu po 'di dag la rtag tu bdag gi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur nas bdag gnyid log pa dang*/ myos pa dang*/ rab tu myos pa yang srung ba dang*/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bkas gsol ba thob cig /'di lta ste/ rgyal ba khru mchog dang*/ 'brog gnas dang*/ gangs gnas dang*/ lngas rtsen dang*/ nor bu bzang po dang*/ grags pa bzang dang*/ lus ngan gyi bus mdzes byed dang*/ phreng ba mdzes dang*/ rgyal po chen po chos skyong rnam thos kyi bu ste/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje bcu po 'di dag rtag tu bdag gi phyi bzhin 'brang bar gyur nas bdag gnyid kyis log pa dang*/

myos pa dang*/ rab tu myos pa na yang srung ba dang*/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bkas gsol ba thob cig /gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ sa ra sa ra ṇi swā hā/ de la lag na rdo rje bcu po de dag gi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams ni 'di dag yin te/ tad+ya thā/ uk+te/ ke te/ saṃ ka te/ ung du le/ dha dhe/ ta te/ ta pa ta he swā hā/ tsi tse tsi tse ci khe lo tsha na ni/ bhe dhe ni/ sarba bīd+ya tshe dā ni/ sarba kri ta ka khorda/ pa ra kri ta nā sha ni/ de la rigs sngags kyi rgyal po chen po lag na rdo rje bcu po de dag gi gsang sngags kyi gzhi dam pa ni 'di rnams yin no// tad+ya thā/ a le lak+ṣe/ pa ke le lak+ṣe/ a ke /pa ke /lak+ṣe swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ hu tu hu tu/ hu tu hu bi tu bi tu/ bi tu tu/ gats+tsha/ sa bhe pa ta ha ta ya swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba te bud+dha s+ya sid+dha yan+tu man+t+ra pā de swā hā// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// /
